cover_letter_text:
Hi Permadec team,

I'd like to apply for the Civil Design Drafter role at Permadec that I saw on SEEK. Your ad describes GRP formwork panel layouts and setout drawings prepared from client and engineering drawings, with quantity take-offs for estimating and quoting, and that mix of careful drafting and quantities is what drew me to it.

I finished the Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design in February 2026. In the course I designed and documented road geometry, earthworks, pavement and stormwater drainage, and prepared and reviewed drawings in AutoCAD and Civil 3D to Australian Standards. It also covered cost estimates and bills of quantities. On a community hall renovation in the Philippines in 2019 I reviewed structural and architectural drawings and checked work against project requirements. My portfolio has a road cross section drawn in AutoCAD and a footing and column modelled in 3D.

I'm based in Melton VIC and have full working rights in Australia (Subclass 485 visa). I can start two weeks after an offer, and I'd be glad to walk you through my drawings on a call.

Kind regards,
Marc Masarate
